housing_building_character: Affluent, established inner-eastern suburb bordering the Yarra River; noted for grand 19th-century Italianate mansions (e.g. Raheen, Villa Alba) and streets with exceptional Edwardian, Victorian and contemporary architecture; among the highest residential resale values in Melbourne.
source_quotes: Kew () is a suburb of Melbourne, Victoria, Australia, found 5 km east from Melbourne's Central Business District. Kew is located within the City of Boroondara local government area. Kew recorded a population of 24,499 at the 2021 census.

Streets in the Sackville Ward (bounded by Barkers, Burke, Cotham and Glenferrie Roads), such as Alfred, Rowland, Wellington, Grange and Sackville, have some exceptional examples of Edwardian, Victorian and contemporary architecture.
As a consequence, many of these residences now attract some of the highest residential resale values in Melbourne.
Raheen is a historic 19th-century Italianate mansion, located at 92 Studley Park Road.
